# Assessment Overview

Supplementary assessment artifacts available in this folder:

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - Two-layer architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency inventory grouped by category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - API endpoints, contracts, and communication sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, ER diagram, and repository patterns.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Runtime/build configuration and secrets inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core business workflows and decision logic.
